lines.japanese: そうだ、そういえば今日は、僕の国で最多発行部数を誇る週刊少年誌の発売日じゃないか。早く帰って今週の『ＤＡＮＧＥＲ×ＤＡＮＧＥＲ』を読みたい。
lines.english: Come to think of it, today was the day the country’s highest-circulation weekly boys’ manga magazine went on sale. I wanted to get home and read this week’s DANGER × DANGER.

lines.japanese: 作者の先生はとても病弱な方らしく、かろうじて不定期連載という形で作品を維持しつづけている。また来週から休養に入られるとも限らない。出来るだけ早く帰って、コミュニティのみんなと盛りあがりたい。
lines.english: The author was apparently in very poor health and only barely kept the series alive as an irregular serialization. For all anyone knew, it might go back on hiatus next week. I wanted to hurry home and join the rest of the community while the excitement was fresh.

lines.japanese: 「山科さん」
lines.english: “Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: 「はねだくん……」
lines.english: “Haneda...”

lines.japanese: 「ここはおれがやるから、先に帰ってていいよ。あとは任せて」
lines.english: “I’ll handle things here. You can head home. Leave the rest to me.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、その……方がいい？」
lines.english: “Oh... Would you rather I did?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。片付けだったら、おれ一人でも出来るし平気だよ。心配しないでいいんだ」
lines.english: “Yeah. I can finish putting everything away on my own. I’ll be fine, so don’t worry.”

lines.japanese: 二人だといろいろ指示を出さなくてはならない。かえって時間がかかってしまうんだ。
lines.english: With two people, I would have to keep telling her what to do. That would only make it take longer.

lines.japanese: 「そう……だね。うん、そうかもしれない。羽田君が一人で帰りたいんだもんね」
lines.english: “I... see. Yes, maybe you're right. You want to go home by yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「そういうわけじゃないけど、ちょっと寄り道したいところがあるんだ。今日はありがとう、山科さん」
lines.english: “That's not why. There's just somewhere I want to stop on the way. Thanks for today, Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: 「うん……じゃあ、また明日……」
lines.english: “Okay... Then I'll see you tomorrow...”

lines.japanese: 山科さんは自分の席に戻って、鞄の中を何度か探っていた。何か失くしたものでもあったんだろうか。
lines.english: Yamashina went back to her desk and rummaged through her bag a few times. Had she lost something?

lines.japanese: でも、僕の片づけが終わる前には見つかったみたいで、教室の前の扉のところまですたすたと歩いていった。そしてそこで上品に手を振って、小さくお辞儀をした。
lines.english: Whatever it was, she seemed to find it before I finished clearing up. She strode to the door at the front of the classroom, then gave me a graceful little wave and bowed.

lines.japanese: 僕はばいばいと言って手を振ると、すぐに片づけを始めて５分で終わらせた。
lines.english: I waved back with a good-bye, then got straight to work and finished the cleanup in five minutes.

lines.japanese: 「でもすぐに帰ると山科さんに追いついちゃいそうだしなあ。５分くらいゆっくりしてから帰ろう」
lines.english: “But if I leave right away, I might catch up with Yamashina. I’ll take it easy for five minutes before I go.”

lines.japanese: ５分後、僕は後ろの扉から教室を出た。もう部活動のひと以外に、誰も残ってなさそうだ。
lines.english: Five minutes later, I left by the rear door. Apart from the students at club activities, it looked as though no one was left.

lines.japanese: すっかり遅くなっちゃった。僕は少し早歩きで昇降口に向かった。
lines.english: It had gotten awfully late. I quickened my pace toward the entrance.

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、高内さん」
lines.english: “Oh, Takauchi.”

lines.japanese: そこで高内さんに出会った。彼女もこんな時間に人がいるとは思ってなかったんだろう。驚いた顔をしている。
lines.english: There I ran into Takauchi. From the surprise on her face, she hadn't expected to find anyone here at this hour either.

lines.japanese: 「あぁーんだよ、なんで今日は何度も羽田に会うんだよ、うぜーなあ」
lines.english: “Oh, come on! Why the hell do I keep running into you today? What a pain in the ass.”

lines.japanese: 「高内さん、こんな時間まで何してたの？」
lines.english: “What were you doing here this late, Takauchi?”

lines.japanese: 「羽田にゃカンケーねーだろ。なんで私のしてること、いちいちあんたに報告しなきゃなんねーの」
lines.english: “None of your damn business, Haneda. Why should I have to report every little thing I do to you?”

lines.japanese: 「おれはさっきまで卒文制作の作業をしてたんだ。わりと進んだんだよ」
lines.english: “I was working on the graduation anthology until just now. We made pretty good progress.”

lines.japanese: 「あーっそ、あんた委員長なんだから当然でしょ。つか、聞いてねーよ、なに勝手に話進めてんだよ」
lines.english: “Oh, good for you. You’re the class president; that’s your job. And I didn’t ask, so why’re you telling me your whole life story?”

lines.japanese: 「そうか、ごめん。じゃあ今度は高内さんの話を聞くよ」
lines.english: “I see. Sorry. Then this time I'll listen to you.”

lines.japanese: 「ハ？　何ソレおまえ、まさか下駄箱まで付いてくるとか言わねーだろーな」
lines.english: “Huh? What the hell’s that supposed to mean? Don’t tell me you’re planning to follow me all the way to the shoe lockers.”

lines.japanese: 「え、だって、下駄箱の場所一緒だよね」
lines.english: “But... our shoe lockers are in the same place.”

lines.japanese: 高内さんは顔をしかめて唸った。僕は卒業文集の進み具合なんかを報告しつつ、彼女の三歩後ろをついていく。どうして三歩後ろなのかと言えば、彼女の歩くスピードが僕より速かったからだ。
lines.english: Takauchi grimaced and groaned. I followed three paces behind her, giving her a report on the anthology's progress. Why three paces? Because she walked faster than I did.

lines.japanese: 「あークソ、部室で寝っ転がってねーで早く帰りゃよかった。キッショー林田の野郎、先輩が寝過してたら気ィくらい利かせて、帰る前に起こしてけっつーの」
lines.english: “Aw, shit. Should’ve gone home instead of crashing in the clubroom. That asshole Hayashida—if your upperclassman oversleeps, have the sense to wake me before you leave!”

lines.japanese: 「あれ高内さん、どこか寄りかかったんじゃない、背中よごれてるよ。白い制服なんだから気をつけなきゃ。ほら払ってあげる」
lines.english: “Did you lean against something, Takauchi? Your back's dirty. You've got to be careful in a white uniform. Here, I'll brush it off.”

lines.japanese: 「へ？　へ？　ぎゃーっ！　てめ、なにひとの背中触ってんだ！　きめえ、超きめえ、なんなんだよキモ羽田。マジ触んじゃねーよ」
lines.english: “Huh? Huh? Aaaah! The hell are you touching my back for?! Gross! Seriously, that’s so gross! What the hell is wrong with you, Creepy Haneda? Don’t fucking touch me!”

lines.japanese: 「違うんだよ、背中に埃が付いちゃってるんだ。待って待って、ほら」
lines.english: “No, you've got dust all over your back. Hold on, hold on. See?”

lines.japanese: 「だーら、てめマジ触んな、それ以上近寄ったら本気で蹴ンぞ！　即死しろ、このっ──」
lines.english: “I said don’t fucking touch me! Come one step closer and I’ll kick the shit out of you! Drop dead, you—”
“—huh?”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　どうしたの高内さん」
lines.english: “Hm? What's wrong, Takauchi?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、なんか……いまそこの角に誰か居たよーな気がすんだけど……」
lines.english: “Nothing. Just... I could've sworn somebody was standing around that corner a second ago...”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「よし、いまのうち」
lines.english: “Good. Now's my chance.”

lines.japanese: 僕は高内さんが見ていた方を向いてみたけど、そこにはなんの影もなかった。
lines.english: I turned to look where Takauchi had been staring, but there wasn't so much as a shadow there.

lines.japanese: もしかしたら、モップかなにかを幽霊と見間違えたのかな。彼女は意外と怖がりさんなのかもしれない。
lines.english: Maybe she had mistaken a mop or something for a ghost. She might be a scaredy-cat underneath it all.

lines.japanese: 「はは、高内さんってかわいいところあるんだね」
lines.english: “Ha ha. You have an adorable side too, Takauchi.”

lines.japanese: だけど振りかえったとき、高内さんはもういなかった。
lines.english: But when I turned back, Takauchi was already gone.

lines.japanese: そうか、彼女も急いでるみたいだったし、一人で先に行っちゃったんだ。
lines.english: Of course. She had seemed to be in a hurry, so she must have gone on ahead by herself.

lines.japanese: 僕も少しでも早くコンビニへ行きたい。すっかりひと気のなくなってしまった校舎を、僕はひとりで昇降口まで向かった。
lines.english: I wanted to reach the convenience store as soon as possible myself. Alone, I made my way through the now-deserted school building toward the entrance.

lines.japanese: コンビニの袋を提げて家に着いた。
lines.english: I got home carrying a convenience-store bag.

lines.japanese: 僕は帰るといつもそうするように、自分の部屋に向かった。パソコンの電源を入れるためだ。
lines.english: As always when I came home, I headed straight to my room to switch on the computer.

lines.japanese: 起動時間が長いから、その間に飲み物を入れるのが常だった。
lines.english: It took so long to boot that I usually fixed myself a drink while I waited.

lines.japanese: コップを取りにいく途中、居間でテレビを見る小鳩が見えた。
lines.english: On my way to get a glass, I saw Kobato watching TV in the living room.

lines.japanese: そうだ、小鳩にもジュースをあげようかな。飲み物がなければ喜んでくれるかもしれない。
lines.english: Maybe I would bring her some soda too. If she didn't already have a drink, she might be pleased.

lines.japanese: 台所でコップを二つ用意して手を止めた。待てよ、僕が買ってきたのはコーラだけど、こういう強い炭酸飲料だと彼女は苦手かもしれない。
lines.english: I set two glasses on the kitchen counter, then stopped. Wait. All I had bought was cola, and she might not like anything that heavily carbonated.

lines.japanese: どうしようかな……なにも言わずに持っていったら、少しかっこいいかもしれない。
lines.english: What should I do...? Maybe I'd look kind of cool if I brought it in without saying anything.

lines.japanese: でも……。
lines.english: But...

lines.japanese: 「小鳩ー、ジュースいるー？」
lines.english: “Kobato! Want some soda?”

lines.japanese: 結局僕は居間に向かって声をかけた。彼女が僕に気を使って、苦手な炭酸飲料なんて飲んだら申し訳ない。
lines.english: In the end, I called out toward the living room. I would feel awful if she drank soda she didn't even like just to be considerate of me.

lines.japanese: 僕は一生気の利いた兄にはなれないかもしれないと思った。
lines.english: Maybe I'd never be a thoughtful big brother.

lines.japanese: 「えっ……ジュース？」
lines.english: “Huh...? Soda?”

lines.japanese: 居間から小鳩が顔を出してきた。僕はコーラのペットボトルを見せる。
lines.english: Kobato peeked out from the living room. I held up the plastic bottle of cola.

lines.japanese: 「う、うんじゃあ……もらう」
lines.english: “Y-yeah, okay... I'll have some.”

lines.japanese: コップを二つ持って、僕は居間に向かった。
lines.english: Carrying both glasses, I went into the living room.

lines.japanese: 「あれっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: すると小鳩は窓の外を眺めていた。なんだろう。
lines.english: Kobato was gazing out the window. What was she looking at?

lines.japanese: 「どうしたの？」
lines.english: “What's wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、外から家のな、なか、覗いてたひとがいたんだけど……もういなくなっちゃった」
lines.english: “Oh... Somebody was looking in from outside, into the h-house, but... they're gone now.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ……誰だろう。気味が悪いね」
lines.english: “Really...? I wonder who. That's a little creepy.”

lines.japanese: 窓から玄関の方を覗くと、そこには人影一つなかった。小鳩の言うとおり、もういなくなったみたいだ。
lines.english: I peered through the window toward the front door, but there wasn't a soul in sight. Just as Kobato said, whoever it was seemed to be gone.

lines.japanese: 「この辺で道に迷って、立ちどまってたんならいいけどね」
lines.english: Hopefully they were just lost around here and stopped for a minute.

lines.japanese: 「うん……あの」
lines.english: “Yeah... Um...”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　なに？」
lines.english: “Hm? What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「き、近所に同じ学校のひと、いる？」
lines.english: “D-does somebody from your school live nearby?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　近所……にはいないと思うよ。それに……」
lines.english: “Huh? Nearby...? I don't think so. Besides...”

lines.japanese: 知り合いが学校に少ないからね。
lines.english: I hardly knew anyone at school in the first place.

lines.japanese: 「そ、そう。じゃあ、見えたの気のせいかも」
lines.english: “O-oh. Then maybe I just imagined it.”

lines.japanese: へえ、この辺にうちの生徒がいたんだ。小鳩はコップを手にとって口につけた。
lines.english: Huh. So there had been another student from our school around here. Kobato picked up her glass and put it to her lips.

lines.japanese: 「けほっ、けほっ」
lines.english: “Kff! Kff!”

lines.japanese: やっぱり炭酸はキツイみたいだ。
lines.english: Looks like fizzy drinks really were too much for her.

lines.japanese: そのあと部屋に戻った僕は、『ＤＡＮＧＥＲ×ＤＡＮＧＥＲ』がやっぱり作者急病による休載だったことについてＳＮＳの仲間たちと語りあった。
lines.english: Afterward, I went back to my room and joined my friends on the social network to talk about how DANGER × DANGER had, sure enough, gone on hiatus again because its author had suddenly fallen ill.
